title: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 3

entities.name: Wayta
entities.description: A young Sun Empire warrior and former pirate who fights the fungal titan, is pushed into the river by the River Heralds, and argues with Quint about who should tell Ixalan's stories.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A loxodon archaeologist who wants to establish a proper excavation site and record the history of the caverns.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: The Sun Empire's warrior-poet who leads the expedition and speculates the golden door may be Matzalantli.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: A Sun Empire officer who fights the titan and organizes the soldiers.

entities.name: Caparocti
entities.description: A Sun Empire officer who fights the titan and organizes the soldiers.

entities.name: Pantlaza
entities.description: A dinosaur companion who claws at the titan and shakes water over Huatli.

entities.name: Abuelo
entities.description: A ghost in a poncho who cannot remember his name, who flees into the ruins and cries 'Titan!' before vanishing.

entities.name: Fungal Titan
entities.description: A hulking mushroom-headed creature with chitinous spikes that heals its wounds with black fungal growth and commands smaller mushroom creatures.

entities.name: Nicanzil
entities.description: A young River Herald scout, daughter of Pashona, who welcomes Wayta and the others to the merfolk city.

entities.name: Pashona
entities.description: Nicanzil's mother, who found the underground merfolk city after the death of the Deeproot Tree.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren and Brazen Coalition emissary who survives with Breeches after the infected pirates attack.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin pirate who helps Malcolm cut the elevator cables and survives.

entities.name: Captain Vance
entities.description: The Brazen Coalition captain to whom Malcolm must report.

entities.name: Bartolomé del Presidio
entities.description: A vampire officer secretly assigned by Queen Miralda to spy on Vito's loyalties.

entities.name: Amalia Benavides Aguirre
entities.description: A vampire cartographer who has visions of a round door and a strange sphere while sinking in sand.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A stranger traveling with the vampires who has been ambushed three times in one day.

entities.name: Vito Quijano de Pasamonte
entities.description: The hierophant leading the Legion pilgrimage, who warns Bartolomé not to undermine him.

entities.name: Clavileño
entities.description: Commander of the soldiers who guard Vito.

entities.name: Kutzil
entities.description: A catlike Malamet champion who captures the Legion and brings them to Sovereign Okinec Ahau.

entities.name: Okinec Ahau
entities.description: The Malamet sovereign who claims there are no gods in his realm and sentences the Legion to the sand.

entities.name: Poq
entities.description: Okinec Ahau's tawny-furred mythweaver, who uses magic to show a vision revealing the vampires' true nature.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: The queen who assigned Bartolomé to spy on Vito.

entities.name: Vona de Iedo
entities.description: A so-called prophet whose faction opposes the queen.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: The vampire god Vito seeks and in whose name he swears.

entities.name: Antifex
entities.description: A figure Bartolomé fears Aclazotz might align with.

entities.name: Tilonalli
entities.description: A Sun Empire deity Wayta prays to for victory.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: The Sun Empire's god, whose light Wayta carries.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane of the caverns.

entities.name: Ban Koj
entities.description: A Malamet city of stalactites with rope bridges and suspended carriages, unseen by outsiders since the Oltec.

entities.name: Matzalantli
entities.description: The legendary door to the birthplace of humankind and home of the gods that Huatli wonders if she has found.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city where the Sun Empire and River Heralds had tense relations before the war.

entities.name: Downtown
entities.description: The abandoned mining camp whose cenote Malcolm explores.

entities.name: Alta Torrezon
entities.description: A vampire city to whose size Ban Koj is compared.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Quint's home plane, where his colleagues are.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who rescue Wayta's party and later capture the Legion.

entities.name: Malamet
entities.description: Catlike underground people ruled by Sovereign Okinec Ahau.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: The vampire pilgrims of Torrezon led by Vito.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of Wayta, Huatli, Inti and Caparocti.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirate alliance Malcolm serves and whose economy depends on the mine.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: An ancient people during whose time Ban Koj last saw strangers.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: A long-dead civilization Quint wonders about.

events.summary: Abuelo cries 'Titan!' and vanishes as Wayta and Quint chase him by an underground river.
events.quote: then vanished in a swirl of purple-pink energy

events.summary: A huge mushroom-headed titan appears and charges Wayta and Quint.
events.quote: Ahead, a hulking figure loomed, easily twice her height.

events.summary: The titan hurls a chunk of wall at Wayta, who dodges and fights it alone.
events.quote: The titan grabbed half of a crumbling wall and threw it at Wayta.

events.summary: Huatli, Inti, Caparocti and the other warriors arrive and attack the titan.
events.quote: Huatli, Inti, Caparocti, and the other warriors had arrived while Wayta was fighting

events.summary: The titan heals its wounds with fungus, kills warriors and spits corrosive black fluid; one warrior dies despite Wayta's attempt to help.
events.quote: the sight of bloody bone through the remains of the man's flesh told her she was too late.

events.summary: A dozen smaller mushroom creatures surround the Sun Empire party.
events.quote: A dozen new creatures surrounded them

events.summary: River Heralds burst out of the river and join the battle, offering to take the party to safety.
events.quote: A wave lashed out of the underground river, knocking two of the creatures away.

events.summary: Quint summons an ancient weapon with a spell and impales a mushroom creature.
events.quote: An ancient weapon rose from the ground as if wielded by a spirit

events.summary: A Herald casts a breathing spell on Wayta and shoves her into the river.
events.quote: Swift travels, little sister

events.summary: On the elevator, spore-infected pirates shove uninjured crewmates into a spore cloud and turn them.
events.quote: those pirates lunged at two of the uninjured ones and shoved them into the glowing spore cloud.

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches cut the cables, sending the elevator with the infected pirates falling into the dark.
events.quote: with a terrible silence, the elevator fell away into the dark.

events.summary: Bartolomé reveals Queen Miralda secretly assigned him to learn Vito's true intentions and loyalties.
events.quote: When Queen Miralda assigned Bartolomé to join this expedition, he was told to play along and discover Vito's true intentions and loyalties.

events.summary: Two dozen catlike Malamet warriors surround the Legion.
events.quote: Two dozen warriors surrounded them, taller than the vampires, broader, with faces like great cats and spotted fur to match.

events.summary: Kutzil introduces herself and demands the Legion come with her.
events.quote: I am Kutzil, champion of the Malamet

events.summary: Vito quietly warns Bartolomé not to undermine him again.
events.quote: Do not undermine me again

events.summary: Kutzil shows the Legion the Malamet city of Ban Koj.
events.quote: You are the first strangers to see Ban Koj since the time of the Oltec.

events.summary: The Legion is brought before Sovereign Okinec Ahau on his throne.
events.quote: This, presumably, was Sovereign Okinec Ahau.

events.summary: Okinec Ahau rejects Vito's claim of a god and has his mythweaver Poq test their words.
events.quote: There are no gods here but me

events.summary: Poq's magic shows a vision of a snarling, fanged face attacking him, exposing the vampires as a threat.
events.quote: A snarling face, its fangs bared and growing long.

events.summary: Okinec Ahau sentences the Legion to be given to the sand.
events.quote: I sentence these trespassers to be given to the sand.

events.summary: Malamet glyph magic binds the Legion in chains and forces them to kneel.
events.quote: The magic lashed out and wrapped around the Legion members like chains, forcing them to kneel.

events.summary: The Malamet throw the Legion, one by one, into a basin of sand that drains into a hole.
events.quote: Bartolomé watched as the Malamet threw his comrades into the basin of sand

events.summary: Amalia tells Kellan to hold his breath just before sinking.
events.quote: Hold your breath.

events.summary: Wayta surfaces in an underground freshwater sea beside Quint.
events.quote: Wayta kicked her way to the surface, searching for the others

events.summary: Nicanzil welcomes the party to the River Heralds' city.
events.quote: I am Nicanzil

events.summary: Huatli wonders if the corroded door atop the temple is Matzalantli.
events.quote: Could this be Matzalantli?

events.summary: Wayta objects to Quint's plan to excavate and write up Ixalan's history for outsiders.
events.quote: You shouldn't be telling our stories for us.

events.summary: Malcolm and Breeches rest in an abandoned tunnel as the only survivors of Malcolm's party.
events.quote: of the eight people he'd brought down here with him, only he and Breeches had survived.

events.summary: Fungus on the shaft wall spells out the words SAFE and DOWN, suggesting the force behind Downtown's fate is sentient.
events.quote: SAFE, the first word read. Then, DOWN.

events.summary: Trapped in the sand, Amalia has new visions of the round glyph door, a map-like sky and a burning sphere ringed with purple-pink debris.
events.quote: The mysterious door, round and covered in glyphs, clearer than before.

events.summary: The Legion falls out of the sand into the same freshwater sea.
events.quote: Without warning, she hit water, her eyes flying open.

events.summary: River Heralds surround and capture the Legion in the water.
events.quote: River Heralds, dozens, all armed with their strange jade weapons and elemental magics.

relations.quote: My mother, the Great Shaper Pashona
Kutzil bared her throat deferentially as she spoke.
Okinec Ahau stood and addressed the assembled Malamet

relations.note: assigned by her to join the expedition

he was told to play along and discover Vito's true intentions and loyalties
the opposition to the queen, the faction supporting Vona de Iedo and other so-called prophets

relations.note: relations tense or hostile since Orazca before the war
relations.quote: relations between the Sun Empire and the River Heralds had been tense, even hostile
The Brazen Coalition kept him too busy.
Breeches gripped the rope with both feet and his tail.
Kellan coughed and swam closer to Amalia.
